verdict.rationale: Rippling provides a documented REST API (v2) with token-based auth, versioning, pagination, and OAuth for App Shop partners, plus an official MCP server, which supports AI-native/programmatic building against the platform. However there is no evidence of official language SDKs (e.g., Python/JS client libraries), only raw REST API + tokens, so 'SDK' claim is only partially met. Missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages in specific languages, SDK versioning/release notes, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
